import type { Register } from 'claude-code'

export const register: Register = (on) => {
  on('session.start', async ($, e, next) => {
    await $.session.id()
    await $.ui.toast({ text: 'hi' })
    await $.fs.read('x')
    return next(e)
  })
  on('tool.call', async ($, e, next) => next(e)).catch(($, e, next) => next(e))
}
